name: Youth Employability Program (BGC South Coast BC)
what_you_do: An 8-week program: about four weeks of job skills workshops and certificate training (First Aid, WHMIS, Superhost, Serving It Right), then up to four weeks of paid work experience with a local employer.
who_can_apply: Ages 15 to 30 who need to find work. The page does not list other eligibility rules.
pay_detail: Participants are paid to take part, with a completion bonus for finishing all 8 weeks. Amounts are not stated on the page. Free to join.
deadline_text: Sessions run every other month (the page gives Oct, Dec, Feb, Apr as examples) and recruiting starts one month before each start date. No events were listed when read.
how_to_apply: Click an event under Upcoming Events on the page to apply. Central office: 604-879-6554 or info@bgcbc.ca. Seats are limited.
notes: Canada, so British Columbia Employment Standards rules have not been added to this guide yet. The page did not say where the workshops are held.
